name: claudio-assistant
description: Creates Claudio, an autonomous office assistant for non-technical professionals of any profession: a ready-made Claude Code folder with first-start interview, learning from your past work, local memory written only with your OK, and drafts you check and sign. The folder it creates has 21 skills: deadlines and agenda, mail sorting and reply drafts, guided jobs, form filling, requests to clients, daily summary, transcription, backup, plain-words explanations, legal research from official sources, weekly read-only update check. Windows, macOS, Linux; docs in EN/IT/FR/DE.
